components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the
            same last name at the same address (an intentionally shared household). Write-only request
            flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A per-owner customer reference formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name at
                the same address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; owners
                in the same household receive the same value. Absent for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where telephone is the E.164 telephone, email is
                the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the shared household id
                (empty when the owner is not in a shared household). Creating an owner whose whole
                identity key equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created, i.e. excluding this
                owner. Zero when the name was unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: A per-owner membership reference formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at creation. Starts at 1;
                adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in
                the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the current
                business day (a high-volume sign-up day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their fields; 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented optional `postcode` validation for owners. When present, a postcode must be 4 digits and, if the owner's city maps to a known region, fall within that region's range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It's stored and returned, and absence keeps the request backward-compatible.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `postcode` field (4-digit string) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so both the request (`OwnerFieldsDto`) and response (`OwnerDto`, via `allOf`) DTOs carry it (regenerated at build).

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a `postcode` column with getter/setter.

3. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres` `schema.sql`) — Added the `postcode` column. Also fixed the hsqldb `data.sql` positional owner inserts (which broke with the new column) by appending a `NULL`.

4. **`CityRegion.java`** — Added the region→postcode-range table (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099) and a `postcodeRangeOf(city)` helper returning `null` for cities with no known region.

5. **`ValidateOwner.java`** — Added optional-when-present postcode validation (4-digit format + region range), mirroring the existing email handling, throwing a new checked `InvalidPostcodeException`.

6. **`InvalidPostcodeException` + handler + escalation YAML** — New checked exception mapped to a 400 response, following the existing `InvalidTelephoneException` pattern.

7. **`ApplyOwner.java`** — Copies `postcode` on the PUT path so updates persist it too.

The three checkpoints — valid postcode stored/returned, owner without postcode accepted, malformed postcode rejected with 400 — all pass.
